Bug_Details:
Leaking resources in an application is never a good idea, as it can lead to memory issues, and even the crash of the application. This rule
template allows you to specify which constructions open a resource and how it is closed in order to raise issue within a method scope when custom
resources are leaked.
Bug_Explanation: A FileInputStream object 'fis' is created but not closed within the showBug method, leading to resource leak.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggered the bug by not closing the FileInputStream object 'fis' in the showBug method of the ResourceLeak class. This leads to a resource leak.
